categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and after-sales services of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) systems, focusing on large fixed-wing, long-endurance UAVs. Its main product line is the Wing Loong series, covering UAVs from 10 kg to 6 tons, serving military and civilian markets with applications in reconnaissance, surveillance, strike, emergency rescue, meteorological observation, and artificial weather modification.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced core technologies including large fixed-wing UAV platform design, composite material structures, intelligent autonomous flight control, modular payload integration, and comprehensive system integration ('air-station-link'). It employs agile R&D processes, digitalized manufacturing with lean production lines, and has developed key technologies such as electric-hydraulic actuation, TSN network communication, and AI-based target recognition. The production capacity supports an annual output of 200 UAVs with flexible manufacturing lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic military and government agencies, international military clients across more than ten countries, and civilian sectors such as emergency management, meteorology, and public safety. The company serves both domestic and overseas markets, with military export sales conducted through authorized military trade companies. Civilian applications focus on emergency rescue, weather modification, and industrial UAV services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. The company exports UAV systems to over ten countries globally, establishing a dual domestic and international market presence. It also operates multiple flight test bases across China and has established innovation centers in Sichuan and Beijing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a midstream and downstream integrator and manufacturer within the UAV supply chain. It functions as the main integrator of UAV systems, managing design, assembly, testing, and delivery, while maintaining a robust and agile supply chain with strategic suppliers to support large-scale production and rapid delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing UAV intelligent autonomy, modular design, and system integration capabilities. The company emphasizes innovation in AI, swarm technology, low-cost manufacturing, and multi-mission payload versatility. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 39.12% R&D-to-revenue ratio in 2024, focusing on new UAV models like Wing Loong-X, weather modification UAVs, and multi-platform collaborative systems. It also builds innovation platforms and collaborates with research institutes to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of UAV systems and related services, including after-sales support, maintenance, and technical services. The company also derives income from government contracts, military exports via authorized channels, and civilian UAV service applications. Sales are conducted mainly through direct sales channels domestically and through military trade companies internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic UAV system integrator and manufacturer, recognized as a national champion in large fixed-wing long-endurance UAVs. It competes in a mature and rapidly evolving military UAV market alongside international players from the US, Israel, and others. Domestically, it holds a strong position with a comprehensive product portfolio and expanding civilian market share, supported by state-owned enterprise backing and advanced technological capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 685 million, a 74.28% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to market demand fluctuations and delayed customer procurement. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 53.9 million. Total assets increased by 18.56% to RMB 8.73 billion, with net assets of RMB 5.69 billion. The company maintains strong R&D investment, with a significant increase in R&D spending by 55.3% year-over-year, reflecting a focus on long-term growth despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a full-spectrum UAV product line with high autonomy, modular payload integration, and multi-mission capabilities, enabling precise reconnaissance and strike functions. Its UAVs are proven in diverse operational scenarios, including military combat, emergency rescue, and meteorological applications. The integration of intelligent control, rapid R&D iteration, and a robust supply chain provides customers with reliable, flexible, and advanced UAV solutions. The company emphasizes comprehensive lifecycle support and innovative service models to enhance customer value.
